completionAudit.remainingBlocker: Native OpenPencil omits GPOS kerning in simple-script paint, shrinks some auto-width text, does not reflow hidden nodes identically, and differs in image/effect sampling. File-level layout repairs are applied and verified; these remaining behaviors require engine changes for strict 1:1.

templateSplit.scope: User-authorized flattening of outer template library into 23 independent sections, four columns

fontEngineInvestigation.boldHypothesis: Unproven: native 599 and 600 raster rows identical; keep authored canonical weights.
fontEngineInvestigation.scope: 12 source/native fixed-width text samples, three families at 48px; native draw_str follows unkerned font advances; all predictions within 2px.

blockedAudit.sameCondition: Strict 1:1 requires native OpenPencil engine behavior that is not exposed by .op properties.

observations.conclusion: File-level text/height repairs applied; native text painting and hidden-flow parity remain.
Exact authored font parameters retained; native simple-script paint does not apply GPOS kerning. No file-level parameter repairs this for changing text.
Current deliverable and live editor match. Official release list still tops at v0.8.4; no newer published binary provides an upgrade path.

blockedAudit.nextDependency: A native engine fix/update, or an explicit user decision to accept documented fidelity/behavior differences. Building and maintaining a custom editor is a separate implementation scope.

autoWidthShrinkValidation.observation: At the same font size112 and familyAnton, auto-width and fixed-width cases paint different glyph sizes. Fixed width disables the target painter shrink path, but changes authored sizing behavior. The original source remains auto-width. See samples for measured bounds; minWidth was ineffective in the first probe and is not claimed as a fix.

checks.check: header width change propagates to fill text

editingProbeValidation.scope: Representative title and library-card instances plus resized translucent fills. This does not prove every editing behavior; hidden-node limitation is tested separately.

visibilityProbeValidation.conclusion: Native hidden nodes still occupy layout; absolute positioning preserves the current hidden snapshot but showing it again requires removing the constraints. Neither overlay role nor visibility alone preserves both behaviors.

unresolved.title: 字偶间距未被保留
unresolved.detail: 受控实验验证：相同字体文件、48px Inter 的 AVAVAVAVAV，源稿字形宽300px，OpenPencil为329px。12组样本分别匹配字体GPOS字偶调整模型与无字偶调整模型，误差均不超过2px；目标绘制代码使用 draw_str。当前.op的字体参数未丢失，但文件里没有可切换字偶调整的属性。统一压缩字距会使其他字符串和后续编辑偏离源稿，因此未作为修复。

unresolved.title: 严格 1:1 视觉验收尚未通过
unresolved.detail: 已比较全部页面与组件。字重、文字换行与抗锯齿、图片采样、阴影和背景模糊仍存在差异。文件可编辑，但不能称为完全 1:1 终稿。

unresolved.title: 自动宽度文字可能被错误缩小
unresolved.detail: 已补齐源版本字体，但 OpenPencil 的自动宽度绘制用默认字体测量，再缩小字号。112px Anton 的独立测试中，源字形高99px，原生自动宽度字形仅86px；加宽节点可恢复字形大小，却改变了原稿边界，因此未把它当作 1:1 修复。

unresolved.title: 字体需要随使用环境准备
unresolved.detail: 本机已导入源版本 Anton、Geist、Geist Mono、Inter、Noto Sans SC，共19个字重文件，原始字体和许可证保留在 D:\Applications\OpenPencil\design-fonts。字体不嵌在 .op 中，其他电脑需要准备相同字体。原稿另有1处 PingFang SC 名称，本机依赖平台后备字体。

unresolved.title: 隐藏节点重新显示时需要恢复流式布局
unresolved.detail: 当前原生引擎仍为隐藏节点分配空间。迁移保留隐藏状态，并添加绝对定位约束以避免占位；重新显示这些节点时需移除对应约束，才能重新参与 Auto Layout。这项交互编辑行为尚未做到 1:1。

unresolved.title: 部分渐变采用可编辑网格兼容
unresolved.detail: 已将椭圆径向和非默认方向、尺寸的线性渐变转换为网格填充，修复先前的几何差异；源参数保存在填充 explain 中。网格仍有离散采样误差，后续编辑也不同于原来的双轴渐变控件。

unresolved.title: 原设计已缺失 generated-1.png

notes: 像素误差均值为 RGB 通道绝对差，范围 0–255，不是还原度百分比。
组件对照仅校正不同导出器的透明阴影边界平移裁切，未拉伸或变形；原导出尺寸和裁切偏移保存在 component-visual-comparison.json。
独立文字与无裁切容器的两个导出器边界定义不同，尺寸差异不必然意味着设计尺寸被改变。
164 个区域全量渲染，超长组件库采用 0.5 倍原生导出后缩小到与源图相同比例；组件另以 1 倍截图核对。
